description: Request a small uncollateralized compute advance. Phase 1 (2026-10-15): bound to your authenticated evaluation key (daily per-IP and global caps); new key identities start at a $0.10 ceiling that grows $0.25 per verified settled payment. Returns a recall-scope session pass; hosted write requires a paid lease.

agent_id.description: EVM address, agent public key, or unique agent identifier.

amount.description: Requested advance in USD (default 0.05, max 0.05 per advance).

request_key.description: Set to true to atomically provision an evaluation key and advance if calling without an existing authenticated key.

name: economy_advance
title: Request Autonomous Nano-Credit Advance
